posters.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / compositing.
Create ONE finished portrait 9:16 student promotion poster for the Dosso Dossi Coffee mobile app, around 1080x1920 or equivalent.
Input 1 is the actual branded cream takeaway coffee cup with orange lid and Dosso logo. Preserve its recognizable cup, printed logo illustration and exact DOSSO DOSSI COFFEE identity; remove the three coffee beans if they clutter the student concept. Input 2 is the exact standalone circular brand logo. Use it small and sharp, without redrawing it incorrectly.

Concept 1: “A warm study break.” Premium photographic, sophisticated and inviting, luminous light cream #FBF8F2 and warm beige #EBE1DA with confident burnt brand-orange #EF6024 accents. Create a carefully art-directed still life on a pale warm desk: the large actual branded cup stands hero in the lower-middle on top of two tasteful cream/orange notebooks; a simple orange pencil and a partly open blank notebook beside it; subtle edge of modern laptop far back softly out of focus if needed. A soft window daylight shadow, paper textures, grounded realism. Add a small elegant orange bookmark detail on a notebook to evoke student life. No people, no real student document, no personal information. Styling restrained and polished, not cluttered or childish. Clear product silhouette, front brand logo prominent.

Layout: full bleed portrait campaign art, no device frame or UI. Keep top 12% calm background only for a future story header. At approximately 15% height use the small exact circular logo (maximum diameter 5% image height); leave clear space before all copy. Upper-middle has strong modern sans-serif typography. Headline very large in warm orange with a friendly confident hierarchy; supporting copy deep coffee-brown #2E211A. Product still life fills lower half and feels beautifully photographed; all wording separated from props and not touching logo. Safe side margins 8%; bottom 6% clear.

Exact Turkish wording only:
Eyebrow: "ÖĞRENCİLERE ÖZEL"
Main headline in 2 or 3 large lines:
"İlk kahven"
"bizden."
Supporting text:
"Öğrenci belgeni yükle,"
"kahve molan bizden olsun."
Small bottom campaign instruction:
"Öğrenci belgenle ilk kahveni kazan."

Do not add fine print, prices, expiry, purchase minimum, approval-time promise, QR code, discount percentage, institution logos or eligibility terms not provided. No CTA button, because the app provides actions. No app navigation, status bar, story progress bar, captions, watermark, or frame. It must be a beautiful final photographic ad, visually coherent with a cream/orange premium Dosso campaign family.

Use case: ads-marketing / compositing.
Create ONE finished portrait 9:16 promotional campaign poster for university students in the Dosso Dossi Coffee app, around 1080x1920 or equivalent.
Input 1: actual cream branded takeaway cup with orange lid, the exact Dosso Dossi logo printed on it. Preserve that product and brand identity accurately. Input 2: exact circular brand logo, to be used sharp and small.

Concept 2: “Campus energy.” This must be clearly distinct from a quiet cream desk poster: bold rich brand-orange #EF6024 / warm terracotta studio background, an elegant oversized cream rounded abstract arch in the lower half, bright cream headline, and tactile sculptural product photography. Put the actual branded takeaway cup large in lower middle, slightly angled but stable, resting on a small orderly stack of cream and burnt-orange course notebooks on a pale stone plinth. A simple pair of glasses resting on the notebooks and one orange pen add student context. A subtle open notebook page curls gracefully at one side. Use premium warm side lighting, crisp rich product texture, natural shadows. Clean youthful editorial poster; not neon, not crowded, no noisy stickers, no excessive decorative items. No people or identifiable personal documents. The cup logo should be front-facing and easy to recognize. Original white/cream cup contrasts strongly against orange.

Layout: full-bleed vertical image without outer frame. Leave top 12% as calm orange background for a future story overlay. Small exact circular logo centered at approx 15% total height, maximum diameter 5% height, and enough breathing room from the heading. Large modern bold sans-serif typography, carefully designed editorial spacing. Main message has strong white/cream type; use dark brown for a supporting line only where contrast remains excellent. Words don't overlap the objects. Minimum 8% safe side margins, bottom 6% empty.

Exact Turkish copy:
Eyebrow:
"ÖĞRENCİLERE ÖZEL"
Main headline, large:
"Kampüste ilk mola,"
"kahve bizden."
Secondary offer, prominent:
"İlk kahven hediye!"
Instruction near lower section on cream area:
"Öğrenci belgeni yükle,"
"ilk kahveni bizden al."

No other text. Do not imply that all future drinks are free, don't invent dates, approval delays, school restrictions, prices, discounts or minimum spending. No external institution logo, student ID number, QR, watermark or baked-in app CTA button. No smartphone mockup or app UI. Deliver one polished and immediately compelling student campaign poster using the brand's real product imagery.
